```yaml
name: Remove Experimental Decorators

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 1 * *'

jobs:
  remove-experimental-decorators:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Run script to remove experimental decorators
        id: remove_decorators
        run: |
          SCRIPT_EXIT_CODE=0
          python dev/remove_experimental_decorators.py || SCRIPT_EXIT_CODE=$?
          echo "::set-output name=script_exit_code::$SCRIPT_EXIT_CODE"
          exit $SCRIPT_EXIT_CODE

      - name: Check if any files were modified
        id: check_changes
        run: |
          CHANGED_FILES=$(git diff --cached --name-only)
          echo "::set-output name=changed_files::$CHANGED_FILES"

      - name: Create PR if changes were made
        if: steps.check_changes.outputs.changed_files != ''
        run: |
          TIMESTAMP=$(date +%Y-%m-%d-%H-%M-%S)
          BRANCH="automated/remove-experimental-decorators-$TIMESTAMP"
          git checkout -b $BRANCH
          git add .
          git commit -m "Automated removal of experimental decorators"
          git push origin $BRANCH

          PR_TITLE="Automated removal of experimental decorators"
          PR_BODY=$(cat <<EOF
This PR was automatically created to remove experimental decorators from the codebase.
The script executed successfully and the following files were modified:
$CHANGED_FILES
EOF
          )

          gh pr create \
            --repo mlflow/mlflow \
            --title "$PR_TITLE" \
            --body "$PR_BODY" \
            --base main \
            --head $BRANCH \
            --label automated
```
